arena: Unchanged published introductory four-track apparatus, primary 192 layouts. Historical results on this panel are known. Not a new blind panel or public preregistration.
selection: No ablations, scratch action-only controllers or one-step world baselines. Only the intact Joint('joint',48) from the paper and named official-weight external models. SmolVLA uses the existing nine independent matches on identical hashed schedules and sealed layouts.
training: Original 16,384 histories, nested annotation IDs and cards, 768 AdamW steps of 128 labeled examples, same seeds and order. Joint is retrained using the unmodified original fit. For new external adapters, use the identical additional independently sampled physical records, stroke and four of twelve optical sensors per row, MSE weight 3. No task actions inferred from the unannotated stream. SmolVLA's archived native flow-action fit did not optimize optics. Equal data access is not equal pretraining, trainable parameters or FLOPs.
new_heads: The two new external models retain the continuous 18 public instrument readings and use the same additive four-coordinate late goal binding as JSTP. Public TRAIN and EXAM goal vectors are never given to the foundation as answers. Train on the final update only, no panel tuning. AdamW lr .001, weight_decay .0001, gradient norm 3.

pi05.method: Strictly load the full official checkpoint. One 224px encoded observation plus the game's public instrumentation in the OpenPI prompt, one control token, zero initial noise, all ten native Euler updates. Learn a terminal action-projection adjustment and an instrument/latent residual adapter, retain the frozen native action as the starting point. Four output coordinates bind a late goal; 24 auxiliary output coordinates predict the two sets of measured optical values. Not all-parameter or full trajectory fine-tuning.

vjepa21.method: Strict-load the official EMA video encoder. Render the archived brightness grids as ordered before/peak views; repeat each twice for the native tubelets. Use spatially pooled temporal tokens and an instrument-conditioned learned readout for task and partial optics; not a native robot planner or V-JEPA-AC.

smol.method: Archived native visual/language prefix and flow action expert; six million parameters updated per fit, exact same data, annotation identities, seeds, exam and scoring. No retraining implied in this entry.

execution: Lock training data, schedule, upstream identities and frozen adapters. Generate commands from public prefix only. Seal them before operating either stroke; re-execute the original simulator and check camera hashes against the paper. Primary: both of two opposite unseen goals solved. Paired bootstrap over 192 whole layouts with all seeds, 3,000 draws, 95% descriptive intervals; corrected primary 128-label intervals across all three official comparators, with per-seed counts. No claim about real robots or a global ranking.
